title: History Dependence in the Housing Market (CEP DP1568)
publisher: LSE Centre for Economic Performance / Bank of England
key_point: England & Wales: home bought in 2007 vs 2001 sells ~5% higher, ~50% less likely to sell; loss sellers list higher on Zoopla.

title: Reference Dependence in the Housing Market
publisher: American Economic Review (accepted version, Imperial Spiral)
key_point: Denmark: hockey-stick list prices vs nominal gains, bunching at zero gain; losses weigh ~2.5x gains.

title: Market Distortions when Agents are Better Informed: The Value of Information in Real Estate Transactions
key_point: Agent-owned homes sell 3.7% higher and stay ~10 days longer; commission incentives push clients to sell too fast, too cheap.

title: Loss Aversion in Housing Sales Prices: Evidence from Focal Point Bias
key_point: Naive loss-aversion estimates fall 50-75% with controls; round-mortgage sellers show ~10pp more loss aversion.

title: Do as Essay, Not as I Do? How Inflated List Prices of Unsold Essayer Homes Affect the Price Discovery Process
key_point: Orange County: unsold essayer listings overpriced 8.1%; spill over raising neighbours' list prices 5.5% and sale prices 5.2%.

title: Brokers' list price setting in an auction context
publisher: International Journal of Housing Markets and Analysis
key_point: Gothenburg condos: underpricing sells faster but 10% more underpricing lowers sale price ~8.5%; broker self-interest.

title: The Effect of Pricing Strategy on Home Selection and Transaction Prices: An Investigation of the Left-Most Digit Effect
key_point: Just-below list prices yield highest transaction price vs value; round prices sell faster with smaller discount.

title: The effect of listing price strategy on real estate negotiations: An experimental study
key_point: Experiment: high precise list price gives highest final price; just-below gives lowest; effects fade with experience.

title: The effect of anchoring transaction prices to offer prices in the housing market
key_point: 17 Polish cities 2010-2022: offer prices were virtually the only significant predictor of transaction prices; anchoring.

title: Loss Aversion and Seller Behavior: Evidence from the Housing Market
key_point: Boston condos: loss-facing sellers list 25-35% of loss gap higher, sell 3-18% higher, sell less often.

title: Focal points and bargaining in housing markets
key_point: Final house prices bunch at round numbers; buyers bargain toward round focal points (metadata only).

title: The price paid: Heuristic thinking and biased reference points in the housing market
key_point: Round-number previous sale prices associated with ~4% resale premium (abstract snippet only).

title: Round-Number Effects in Real Estate Prices: Evidence from Germany
key_point: Professionals cluster on round prices substantially less than private sellers (abstract only).

title: Crafting Lucky Prices in the Housing Market
publisher: B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis & Policy
key_point: Prices cluster on round and lucky digits (8); ~2.4% hedonic premium for lucky-priced homes (abstract only).

title: Information transparency and pricing strategy in the Scottish housing market
publisher: International Journal of Housing Markets and Analysis
key_point: Aberdeen: after Home Report, artificially low 'offers over' asking prices declined; pricing tracks nearby comparables.

title: Rightmove House Price Index May 2026
key_point: Reduced homes took ~127 days to find buyer vs 36 days if priced right; 32% reduced; London asking -2.4% YoY.

title: Rightmove House Price Index January 2026
key_point: About a third of listings had asking price cut; sellers urged to heed agent and avoid over-optimism.

title: Zoopla UK House Price Index September 2026
key_point: Only 30% of London Q2 listings found buyer within 3 months vs ~75% Scotland, ~50% northern England.

title: RICS UK Residential Market Survey August 2026
key_point: Price balance -28%, agreed sales -17%; London declining more steeply than UK average; appraisals down.

title: Estate agents at odds over overvaluing to win instructions
key_point: GetAgent survey: 89% of agents lost instructions to higher valuers; 95% say overvaluation harms sellers.

title: Estate agents only getting paid on 50% of listings
key_point: Only ~50.9% of listings exchange/complete; 14.3% reduced in June; fall-through 24.2%; overvaluation blamed.

title: Sealed bids make a surprise return amid fragile marketplace
key_point: Prime London Q2 2019: 16% of Savills deals competitive, 56% of those sealed bids, despite falling prices.

title: Half of homebuyers paid the full asking price or higher for their property
key_point: 49% paid asking or above; 39% got discounts (20% up to 5%, 14% 5-10%, 6% >10%); sealed bids ~2%.

title: Modest growth highlights importance of realistic pricing, say experts
key_point: London tenth month of annual declines; agents say buyers have more choice, price realistically from day one.

title: Bidding wars and sealed bids
key_point: 2021 boom: best-and-final standard for desirable homes; 15-30%+ over guide; comments note flats lagging.

title: Don't seal your bids, open them
key_point: Auctioneer argues open bidding beats sealed bids; auction fall-through <1%, completion ~40 working days.

title: Great Expectations
key_point: Ombudsman cases: sellers accuse agents of inflate-then-cut; agents must document valuation reasoning in writing.

title: Estate agent advice - selling leasehold flat in London
key_point: Beckton flat bought £275k: five valuations £265k-£325k; seller floor anchored on purchase price; flats slow in London.

title: Overpriced house offer rejected, what now?
key_point: Listed £850k, cut to £800k, relisted £775k; buyer offer £700k on comparables; advice: final offer then walk.

title: How can I tell if individual house prices are falling?
key_point: Users track comparables and reduction history via Rightmove and Property Log extension; averages seen as useless.

title: Negotiating best purchase price
key_point: Asking £325k became £300-325k guide; buyers use prior sale price and time listed to set offers.
